description: Custom encounter sequence. Supported step types: press | pause | hold | combo | verify_screen | check_shiny. Input keys: x (A button), z (B button), enter (Start), backspace (Select). verify_screen takes a screenshot and checks it against the encounter template — fails to restart if wrong screen. check_shiny compares the screenshot to your calibration reference — stops the hunt if shiny, restarts if not. Both screenshot steps use config defaults but accept optional overrides (threshold, reference_path).
